newsitem.title: USA: Marriott International reports higher profits.
newsitem.headline: Marriott International reports higher profits.

text.p: Marriott International Inc. Thursday reported higher earnings for the latest quarter, thanks to a 22 percent gain in revenues.
The hotel giant said it earned $83 million, or 61 cents a share, in the second quarter, up from year-earlier profits of $75 million, or 55 cents a share.
Sales jumped to $2.87 billion from $2.35 billion.
Marriott said its $1 billion acquisition of Renaissance Hotel Group N.V., a worldwide operator and franchisor of hotels, trimmed its profits by $6 million.
Marriott's stock was unchanged at $65.31 on the New York Stock Exchange.
